observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a heavy red/pink painted cast-metal housing with multiple large circular openings (bellhousing/banjo-style casting), bolted or seated against a large toothed flywheel.
Flywheel is yellow-brown, visibly rusted/oxidized, with a full ring of gear teeth around the circumference and a central hub with bolt holes.
Items sit outdoors on bare dirt/gravel next to other used industrial equipment (pumps, motors), suggesting a scrapyard or used-parts yard.
No engine tag, part number, casting number, or 'Detroit' / '6V71' marking is legible in either photo.
No ruler, tape measure, or other scale reference is visible to confirm the stated 19-inch dimension.
Surface rust is visible on the flywheel; the housing shows chipped paint and some surface dirt/oxidation but no visible cracks in these shots.
Watermark 'DNL EQUIPMENT SALES AND...' overlays both photos, indicating these are reused/stock listing images rather than necessarily photos of this exact unit in the seller's current possession.

identity.kind: diesel engine flywheel and flywheel housing (banjo housing) assembly

claims.claim: Flywheel and Banjo for Detroit engine 6v71
claims.evidence: No casting number, engine tag, or '6V71'/'Detroit' stamp is visible in photo 0 or photo 1; claim rests on seller's words only.
No tape measure, ruler, or known-size reference object appears in either photo to confirm this dimension.

risks.risk: Part may not actually fit a 6V71 engine (wrong application) despite seller's claim.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of stamped casting/part number on the housing and on the flywheel hub.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used diesel flywheel/housing of unconfirmed application, not as a verified 6V71-specific part

risks.risk: Flywheel ring gear teeth may be chipped, worn, or missing in sections, affecting starter engagement.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short clip panning around the full circumference of the gear teeth.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown/possibly damaged ring gear, i.e. at worst case (damaged)

risks.risk: Housing casting may have hairline cracks, especially around the bolt holes or openings, not visible at this distance/angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each opening edge and the mounting flange from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, assume possible crack/damage

risks.risk: Internal bearings, bushings, or seals (if any originally housed in the banjo) may be missing or seized; housing openings appear empty in both photos.
risks.proof: Photo looking directly into each bore to show presence/absence of bearing races or seals.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare casting only, no internals included

risks.risk: Corrosion/rust on the flywheel may be only surface-level or may indicate deeper pitting affecting balance.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of flywheel face and friction surface, plus any machining marks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as rusted/surface-damaged, worst case for resale finish

risks.risk: Stock/reused photos (watermark) may not represent the actual unit currently for sale, raising risk the item differs from what's pictured.
risks.proof: A fresh photo with today's date/newspaper or seller's own unwatermarked image, plus the item in current location.
risks.if_unproven: priced with added discount for unverified current possession/condition

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any stamped part/casting number on the banjo housing and on the flywheel hub.
Photo with a tape measure against the flywheel diameter to confirm the 19-inch claim.
Full 360° video or multiple photos of the ring gear teeth.
Close-up photos of the housing openings/bores showing whether bearings or seals remain.
A current, unwatermarked photo of the exact item in the seller's possession, ideally with a dated marker.
response.reason: The item type (a used diesel flywheel and housing/banjo assembly) is clear from the photos even though no model markings are legible, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified-fit, surface-rusted, bare casting pending proof of application, dimensions, and internal condition.
